rationale: Features: 16 prediction-time fields (7 categoricals incl. drg_present, 5 numerics, 4 binary flags). Excluded identifiers (claim_id, member_id, rendering_npi) and fraud_pattern_type, which is label-derived: it is null on 12198/12845 rows and populated only for positives, so it would leak the label (it is in the catalogue default and must be removed). Also excluded high_cost_flag as a derived flag redundant with the amount features. Split: test_size 0.25 (a quarter held out) with stratify=true so prevalence is preserved and reported per partition; the seed comes from the run. Preprocessing: fit_on=train_only (catalogue default all_data leaks test distribution into encoder/scaler); standard scaling since logistic regression is scale-sensitive. Models: logistic_regression plus random_forest as the single tree-based model; class_weight=balanced because prevalence is ~5% (~647/12845) and the component scores at a fixed 0.5 threshold, where unweighted models collapse to near-zero recall. Report: the four caveats map one-to-one to the required limitations (synthetic label, class imbalance, baseline model, no operational use); denominators shown for every rate and every result bullet cited to model_metrics.json / feature_list.json / metrics keys for traceability.
